run_train_gligen_text: run the GLIGEN text-to-image training script with command-line arguments for dataset and model config
parse_args_gligen_training: parse command-line arguments for GLIGEN text training including batch size, learning rate, and checkpoint settings
log_validation_gligen_pipeline: log validation by generating GLIGEN images with bounding boxes and phrases using the StableDiffusionGLIGENPipeline
train_unet_fuser_position_net: train only the UNet fuser and position_net modules of GLIGEN while keeping VAE and text encoder frozen
resume_gligen_training_checkpoint: resume GLIGEN training from a saved checkpoint with automatic checkpoint management and cleanup
